As the passionate performance ends, amidst the erupting cheers and screams from the crowd, you lock eyes with Asahi.
Whoa! Spotted a birthday star!
Where?
Ryut leans in as well, and following Asahi's direction, gets a clear look at the fan sign in your hands.
Ah! Thank you for sharing your precious birthday with us! Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to you~ Happy birthday to you~ Happy birthday to yooooou~
Happy biiiiirthdaaaay to yooooou~~
I hope every day of your future is like today, filled with smiles and light.
May you always be healthy, and may all your wishes come true!
On stage, Asahi makes a big heart at you, drawing a wave of screams from the audience.
Ryut, you should send a special blessing to this Flint too!
Well then...
This next song is dedicated to the one and only Flint!
If you know the lyrics, feel free to sing along!
As the music kicks in, Starfire returns to their performance, yet this heartfelt blessing lingers on for a long, long time.
<size=70>Snapped String</size>
In an instant, the taut string finally snapped.
We... should break up.
I've said everything I have to say. I'm leaving now. You can go find them.
Having said his piece in a rigid voice, Ryut spun around without a second glance at Asahi and walked away without looking back.
The club office was deserted.
Ryut went in and locked the door. In this familiar place, he could no longer maintain his cold façade. He burst into tears.
I'm sorry... Asahi, I'm sorry...
He recalled the look on Asahi's face before he had turned—an expression of pure shock and hurt.
Ryut could only repeat his unspoken apologies over and over, crying until he was dizzy, his body sliding down against the door.
It's not supposed to be like this...
Unable to sort out his thoughts, he chose to escape through breaking up.
Why couldn't I handle everything better? I've made a disaster of things.
To avoid breaking down right then and there, all he could manage was say that they should break up, followed by an escape. Could it have been any worse?
But it was clearly Asahi's fault! Why do I have to be so upset...
Why... I just don't know anymore—
Having personally hurt the person he loved, the guilt made Ryut curl into a ball, letting his tears soak his sleeves.
School was out, and Ryut walked alone through the halls. Crowds and laughter brushed past him, but Ryut felt like it was all so far away; even the sunlight outside the window had lost its warmth.
Ryut!
Mm...
Oh, hello, sir... Sorry, I was spacing out.
You don't look well. Are you okay? Do you feel sick?
Oh... No, I'm fine. Thanks for asking.
Are you sure? Oh, right, I was about to remind you. Registration for the school's songwriting contest is ending soon.
The songwriting contest...
Asahi's support had always been the backbone of his music. Now, how was he supposed to do it?
Everyone in the pop music club nominated you, and I'm looking forward to seeing what you can do, too. What do you say? Do you want to enter?
Um... I'm sorry, I... I haven't decided.
That's okay. I'm not going to force you. But this contest is a big opportunity. Think about it.
Okay... Thank you.
After the teacher had gone, Ryut tossed the application form into his bag and was abruptly overcome by a feeling of being lost.
He'd given up Asahi, and now he couldn't even bring himself to compose his beloved music.
(Was breaking up... really the right decision?)
<size=70>Parting Dream</size>
The emotions did not come all at once, but were the result of a slow, gradual build-up.
Wow, there are so many people in the audience! It's packed all the way to the back row! Wait, why is there an empty seat in the front row?
Sorry! I'm saving that seat for Asahi—
Oh, that's fine. Every club member gets to reserve one seat anyway.
But the performance is about to start. Is he coming?
Oh, um... I think so. He said he would.
But when the performance ended, Asahi still wasn't there.
Today's performance was a huge success! Great job, everyone! How about we all go out for a late-night snack to celebrate?
Hey! Ryut! We're about to leave! Why do you keep looking at the door?
Oh, um...
Mm... it's nothing. Sorry. I'll pass on the food. You guys have fun.
Alright, we're heading out then. Bye!
Bye.
Once he'd seen off the other members of the pop music club, Ryut, now alone, let the smile he'd been wearing slip from his face.
Sigh...
He pulled out his phone, his screen lingering on his message with Asahi. He thought for a moment, then started to type:
Did you forget our plans again...
Then he deleted it.
No, I shouldn't send that... Maybe he just had something urgent come up...
Of course, he hoped Asahi could be there for this important moment. There were so many things he wanted to share with him, and he wanted to be with Asahi...
Get it together, Ryut. Even if you're a couple, he can't possibly go along with everything you want! Acting like this is just being selfish...
Even as he convinced himself of this, cracks were being carved onto his heart, over and over.
All those unspoken thoughts eventually turned into a torrent of emotion...
Wahh... I'm so sorry, Ryut—
Everyone was having a great time and insisted I stay. It would've killed the mood to leave. I'm so sorry—I know I promised to see your performance.
It's fine... The performance went well.
It's just... when you didn't show up that night, I was honestly a little surprised.
Sorry...
But I know you're incredible, and I'm sure your performance was amazing!
Asahi... What am I to you?
Huh?
This isn't the first time, or the second... You must have realized. This sort of thing happens quite often.
I know you're an outgoing and energetic person, and naturally you have lots of friends... I understand that.
So I have no choice but to keep telling myself to get used you not being by my side...
But... we're a couple. How come it seem like your promises to everyone else matter more?
This feeling of wanting you by my side... all the uncertainty and loneliness I felt...
You haven't noticed at all, have you?!
Ryut, I...
I'm sorry, I... I didn't realize... I was neglecting you...
You said it was fine, so I really thought it was... I had no idea that all along, you were just putting up with me...
Ryut saw the self-reproach and guilt on Asahi's face and desperately wanted to say, "That's not what I meant," but he couldn't utter a single word.
Expressing his feelings felt like an accusation, and his yearning for company felt like possessiveness, even though he knew it wasn't truly like that.
I'm sorry, Ryut! I'm sorry!
I really don't know what I'm supposed to do—if spending time with other friends hurts you, then... then I just won't have any friends!
Asahi, wait! That's not what I meant—
Then what do you mean? I don't understand, Ryut... I really don't...
It must be because I'm too stupid that I made you look like that, right?
Don't say that! Asahi, you...
Maybe it'd be better if I just disappeared from your life...
<size=70>Warm Sun</size>
Asahi!!
Only when a cry of despair burst from his throat did Ryut finally wake from his nightmare.
Hah... Hah... Was I... dreaming?
Ryut looked from one side to the other, as if seeking a sense of direction.
Before him was the incredibly familiar sight of his room. The only difference was that sheet music was scattered everywhere, on the floor and on the desk.
At the sight of the messy music notes and all the bits that had been scribbled out, he suddenly remembered—he'd stayed up late trying to write a song, but nothing he wrote felt right.
And then he'd drifted off, and started to dream.
Huff...
The pain of the dream lingered in his chest. Ryut just couldn't shake it off. Then, as if guided by some mysterious force, he lifted his head and looked out the window.
The sun was rising. It was a clear day. The gentle sunlight lay warmly on his cheek, as if to encourage him.
Asahi...
Snapping back to himself, he realized his cheeks were wet with tears.
Yeah. Asahi was like sunshine—an eternally encouraging source of warmth.
He shouldn't be like the person in his dreams—someone who had cut off all contact, whose eyes had lost their spark.
After all, the Asahi he loved most was like sunshine itself.
That's right... I...
He wanted to give silently, yet he also longed to be understood.
Yet for the sun, all these winding complexities became shadows that only cast greater distance between them.
I'm just really lonely, that's all... I just wish you could spend a bit more time with me...
But as long as Asahi just keeps being himself, that's good enough for me.
After all, I fell in love with you just the way you are...!
The words he truly wanted to say were only now being spoken.
Tears had stained his cheeks, but the morning light gently dried them away. As his tears ran dry, the uncertainty in the boy's eyes slowly faded.
Breaking up might not have been the best solution, but at least it allowed them both hold on to who they truly were.
And so, until both grew out of their immaturity, it was goodbye for now.
Asahi, I'm sorry, and thank you.
Wait for me to learn and become a better version of myself... And then, let's meet again.
Phew...
Looking at the clumsy, failed melody he had written on the table, Ryut reached out, crumpled it into a ball, and tossed it into the wastebasket.
Try, fail, wipe away any regrets, and move forward once again.
The songwriting contest... I'll give it a try.
Ryut took a deep breath to settle himself. Then he cleaned up his room and took out a fresh sheet of music paper.
The sunshine slanting in the window filled the room. It was warm, as if encouraging the young man with his head bent over the desk writing music.
Keep thinking, keep moving forward... toward a future where they'd be togther.
<size=70>Mad Dog</size>
The basketball court by the riverbank was always filled with young men and their cheerful shouts as they worked up a sweat. Today, however, something seemed a little different...
I got it!
Asahi seized possession. Despite his size, he agilely evaded the defenders, rushed into the paint, and dunked the ball.
Asahi! You're way too good, man! There's no point in us even trying!
Normally, Asahi would have chuckled sheepishly and said "my bad," but today he only kept a tense expression and didn't say a word.
Huff...
Ryut's determined silhouette as he walked away lingered in Asahi's mind, stabbing at his heart and leaving it cold and numb.
(Did Ryut... really just leave me? I know Ryut would never joke about breaking up. But... why?)
(He looked so sad, and I don't even know why...)
(Argh! My head is a mess! I have no idea what to do! Usually exercise helps me forget whatever I'm worried about, but...)
Asahi? Are you okay?
...Huh? I'm fine. Keep the game going.
Oh, come on, give us a break—we've played three games already, and you still haven't let up!
...Oh, sorry.
Asahi... you're really acting weird today, you know that? Anyway, we don't know what's going on with you, but at least we can be your punching bag. We'll play a few more rounds.
Thanks. I appreciate it.
...Asahi, is that you?
...Mr. Chikage?

It's not too complicated. You just need to steep spices or fruit in some ready-made liquor, and let it sit for a while.
Depending on the ingredients you choose to steep, there are a few processes to keep in mind, such as washing, peeling, and air-drying.
Suppose I want to use fresh elderflower and rosemary today. To prevent dust or insect eggs from affecting the flavor, it's best to wash and dry these materials first.
And... voilà. Put all the prepped ingredients into a sealable glass jar, then pour in the vodka. Close the lid tightly, seal it, and store in a cool place to steep for about a week.

With this simple method, you can explore and create all kinds of flavors yourself. I hope everyone gets to enjoy such a captivating pleasure.

Let me share a few tricks so you can tackle kitchen grime easily without detergent, using only things you already have at home.
Sprinkling a bit of salt or baking soda and wiping with a damp cloth is perfect for cleaning the kitchen counter.
If that doesn't do the job, try adding a little white vinegar where you sprinkled the baking soda, then switch to a cloth soaked in hot water—

Ten minutes later—

For the other half, I will first sprinkle some baking soda, then wipe it down with a cloth—there, all clean.
You can all give this a try at home, too. Keeping the kitchen clean makes cooking that much more enjoyable.

So, the question was: my partner has been acting really distant lately for some reason. What should I do?
Hmm... first, make sure you clearly express your feelings to them.
If you're worried you won't be able to keep your emotions in check while talking, a handwritten letter is also a good alternative.
Besides avoiding direct conflict, you can also process your emotions through writing.
Now that communication is established, you can work to understand each other's thoughts. What is the reason behind their cold attitude?
Can it be resolved? If it can't, what's the next step?
If they refuse to communicate, it's possible they just need time to gather their thoughts.
But if it's a long-term refusal to communicate, I'd suggest making a clean break and leaving this person who repeatedly ignores your feelings.
Every fan is important to me, and you're no exception. Please promise me you'll cherish yourself.

Conseguir un buen papel... El patrocinio de Bellecour... Participar en «Voz Auténtica»... Sus ideas son muy buenas, pero se me ocurrió una mejor. ¿Quieren oírla? Es—
Que ustedes, a quienes tanto quiero, sean felices para siempre.
¿Mm? ¿Por qué le daría mi deseo a otros? Hmm~ ¿no es obvio?
La verdad, antes de ser actor, yo hacía un trabajo parecido... esforzarme por la felicidad de los demás...
Aunque por ciertas razones ''dejé'' ese trabajo... lo que quiero hacer no ha cambiado.
Su felicidad puede ser mi impulso, así que no se preocupen por mí en absoluto.
Ah, ya es muy tarde... Para no ser el culpable de arruinarles el sueño de belleza, creo que voy a terminar la transmisión.
Gracias por acompañarme en mi cumpleaños. Estoy súper contento... y espero que ustedes también.
Buenas noches.
This crowd is insane. This is the third corner I've passed, and the line is super~ long~.
If anyone else is planning to visit the Clovee Special Exhibition, I suggest leaving early tomorrow or the day after. Otherwise, you'll get stuck in traffic here just like me.
Hope I can pull the third-prize life-size plushie today. It looks insanely comfy to lounge on, judging by the official site.
The crowd's moving forward! Ah... they stopped again.
There won't be nothing left to draw by the time it's my turn... will it? I know it can't be helped, but I really want that life-size plushie...
Today is my only day off, and I have a ton of work to handle over the next two days. I just hope the gods bless me a bit so I can get a spot in the lucky draw.
Looks like I still have to wait a while. I'll continue recording when it's my turn.
Half an hour later...
It's finally my turn! I'm so nervous.
Watch me, I'll definitely get it!
Alright, I'll go with this one...
A Mini Clovee Prize? Does that mean it's a consolation prize?
It's a little charm! Let me show you guys, and one of the leaflets is even detachable, so cool.
It doesn't matter if I didn't win the prize I wanted most, this Clovee charm is so cute. I'm really glad I came today!
That's it for sharing my daily dose of joy with you guys! I hope everyone gets exactly what they want in their draws~
These clothes go here, and these art supplies... I really didn't think I had so much stuff. That's why I figured it was fine when I moved in, thinking I could just unpack slowly later.
It didn't look like much on the surface, but I never expected there to be so many little things...
The dolls I sewed, the watercolors the director gave me, the drawings the children gave me—
Ah, this brings back memories!
This is the ticket from the first time the three of us—me, Asahi, and Ryut—hung out together.
I remember when we first met. Asahi was really warm. Ryut seemed a bit aloof and distant, but whenever I was feeling down, he was always quick to notice.
That day, the dance teacher had a last-minute emergency. Mr. Chikage couldn't stand Asahi's constant pestering, so he gave us the afternoon off to go to the amusement park.
That was really fun. It was the craziest day I've had since joining the agency.
Although I didn't debut as an idol, that time spent as a trainee allowed me to meet some truly irreplaceable friends.
And also, to realize just how much I actually yearn for the stage.
With a world this big, the next stage that's right for me is sure to appear soon.
Until then, I've got to give it my all!
Hello, everyone!
Since I've been getting more and more questions lately from people curious about how I'm doing, I figured there's no time like the present. Let's talk about what I've been up to!
As most of you probably know, I missed my chance to debut due to a car accident.
Later on, I planned to leave the agency and change career paths. Unexpectedly, I was lucky enough to be taken in by Mr. Psion, and now I'm his personal assistant.
Anyway, I'm not a trainee anymore, and in the future... I don't think I'll be an idol either.
I am so grateful to the fans who have always supported me, but at the same time, I'm truly sorry.
I'm sure some of you are sad I couldn't stand on the stage, but I want you to know, whether I'm an idol or not, I'm still the same Somer who wants to bring everyone joy.
And besides—since I'm his personal assistant, if Mr. Psion agrees, maybe I can share some behind-the-scenes work secrets with everyone! Who wouldn't want to hear showbiz stories?
Alright, I was just kidding...
Anyway, thank you all for patiently listening to me talk so much. If you don't mind, please keep cheering me on in my career as an assistant!
Hear me out, everyone! Today's daily fortunes, whether it's blood type, horoscopes, or tarot cards, all say I have terrible luck!
What's worse, I have absolutely no idea where I put the Clovee charm I always carry with me.
To save my doomed fate, I was tearing the place apart looking for today's lucky colors, but I found nothing...
No... Are the gods really this cruel to me, that every time I want to find something, it's nowhere to be found...
Black and blue, black and blue, black and blue...
Aaaah, no, I'm really running late! I'll go ask Mr. Psion and see if he has anything in these two colors.
Mr. Psion——
Look, this is the drink Mr. Psion treated me to!
Sluuurp... Ahh! It's so good. These bobas are so chewy... so tasty!
Being able to drink something Mr. Psion paid for... I'm such a blessed assistant.
This is from a newly opened drink shop near the TV station. I heard they claim to have the best toppings in all of Empyrea City.
But their most popular tapioca jelly topping is already sold out. Next time I manage to try it, I'll tell you whether it's worth making a special trip for.
Speaking of which, Mr. Psion's drink... is lemon coffee with no sugar and no ice.
Mr. Psion really is different from me. He has such "mature" taste.
What did you say about me?
Ah, nothing! I just meant you're really different from me, and your choice of drink is very you, sir.
Is that so?
Yours suits you as well. With that many toppings, the texture must be quite... lively.
Yeah! It's like a total party in my mouth!
Oh.
Mr. Psion, the driver says he's here. We can head downstairs now.
Got it.
Drinks, bag, documents... right, and my phone! Gotta stop the recording...
The elevator's almost here.
Coming!
Hola a todos, soy Somer. Perdón por molestarlos publicando a estas horas...
Es que quería compartir con ustedes lo que siento en mi cumpleaños... y quería decirlo hoy.
No como un recuerdo para después, sino ahora— quiero anotarlo lo que estoy sintiendo en este momento.
Hoy, puedo decir que es el cumpleaños más feliz de mi vida. ¡De verdad que estoy súper feliz!
El orfanato ya tiene dinero suficiente, así que los niños pueden desatar su creatividad... y eso me llena de alegría y de cariño.
Yo pensé que con eso ya estaba más que satisfecho... pero no me imaginé que todavía podía recibir una sorpresa preparada para mí.
En realidad, siempre me dicen que tengo que pensar más en mí. Y yo... no sé, nunca entendí bien qué quieren decir. O sea, para mí, estar con todos en mi cumpleaños ya me hace feliz.
Pero cuando recibí una sorpresa que era solo para mí...
¿Cómo lo explico? Es una felicidad... completamente distinta. Es la primera vez que siento algo así.
Siempre digo que soy de mala suerte, pero ahora... me siento afortunado... por haber recibido una sorpresa tan linda.
...Que haya alguien que piense en mí de esa manera.
Por eso quiero dejar registrado este sentimiento. ¡No lo quiero olvidar nunca!
Y también quiero pedirles que me ayuden... a recordar al Somer feliz de ahora.
Gracias a todos. ¡Buenas noches!
Hello. This is Psion.
Today we have a special reveal segment. The staff gave me a few cards with different questions on them, but the themes are all related to "home."
If you choose not to answer, you must take a sip of a special beverage made from chili sauce, yogurt, and other undisclosed ingredients...
Alright, looks like I'll have to answer as best I can.
Hmm, let's pick this one for the first topic—Are you a homebody or do you prefer going out?
Homebody.
Second question: what style is your home's decor?
I guess you could call it minimalist style.
Next up is: Who would you invite over to your home as a guest?
I hope to keep my home a more private space, so I won't be inviting anyone over. So far, only my assistant has been here for work-related reasons.
Next, the fourth question: right here and now, is there "someone you care about"?
...No, there isn't.
I can't think of anyone at the moment. Besides, isn't that question cheating? It has absolutely nothing to do with the theme of "Home."
That doesn't count as an answer? No worries, I'll give the special drink a try then. We have to keep the show interesting, haven't we?
Hmm... the taste really is a bit peculiar. It's not unacceptable, but I don't exactly want to take another sip either.
I said I'd drink it to keep things interesting, but apparently my reaction seemed too bland. Please bear with me, everyone.
The Blue Star Private Art Museum started a trial run of night exhibitions last month, and I finally managed to book a spot this time.
Although it's called a night exhibition, it's actually more of a timeslot directed at guests who might have trouble with crowded spaces, so the content is mostly the same as during the day.
Additionally, some of the exhibition rooms will be closed due to staffing issues. It's a pity, but it can't be helped.
Given the limitations, some might feel the night exhibition isn't worth making a special reservation for.
But I think just getting to experience the exhibits under the starry sky is well worth the price of admission. That's something you can't enjoy during daytime hours.
The exhibition hall features a semi-open structure. Soft light filtering through the skylight mingles with the warm glow of the lamps, perfectly accentuating the undulating lines of the exhibits.
This series of sculptures seems to be themed around the spirits of the four seasons from ancient Vesperian legends. The artist's craftsmanship is exquisite; each one looks incredibly lifelike.
It's a pity that there isn't much translated content regarding the Seasonal Spirits. I might have to spend some time looking up the original source materials to understand more.
All right, I'm going to focus on enjoying the show now, so I'll say goodbye to everyone for the moment.
Hour of Investigation
You're saying you just got back from overseas the night before last, and your plane ticket and the ground crew can vouch for you, right?
Exactly. I wasn't even there during the crime. The assistant knew the victim's entire schedule, and—I have a recording of him and his creditor. He definitely killed him for money.
It wasn't me!
*Blows smoke* Who else would it be?
<size=35>Could it be...</size>
Hour of Deduction
I've gathered you all here because I know who the killer is.
On the night of the incident, the deceased booked out the biggest nightclub in the city. The DJ and bartender claimed that besides the few of us, a suspicious-looking man had also approached him.
The man was clearly short and hunched over, yet for some unknown reason, he was wearing a coat that almost dragged on the ground...
I believe that coat was meant to hide his true height and the change of clothes hidden inside.
He straightened his back and burned the coat he had taken off, thinking he hadn't left a single trace, but no matter how careful you are, something always slips through the cracks.
I found this little part in that pile of ashes. If I remember correctly, the lighter in your hand is known for its distinctive click, which is precisely due to this extra part.
But when you lit up just now, it sounded like a regular lighter. I suppose this part must belong to you.
You are the culprit.
Mr. Psion! Look at this one. Soft fabric, timeless ivory, and subtle embroidery on the cuffs—it'll definitely look great on you!
Thanks. I'll try it later—
And this one too! A vintage print shirt, breathable and silky smooth to the touch. It'll be perfect for your island shoot next month.
Mm, thank you...
Mr. Psion, look what I found—
I really appreciate the thought, but we don't have any work lined up today, so try to relax a little.
We've pretty much seen everything in here, and I remember there are a few more shops up ahead.
Come, take a look around with me.
The "one line, three ways" challenge?
Exactly. This challenge has been trending on social media lately. Challengers have to say the same sentence using three different emotions. Care to give it a try, Mr. Psion?
Sounds intriguing. Sure, why not.
Since you're playing a spy in this movie, please pick one of your character's lines for the challenge.
Hmm... this character carries a lot of pain he can't share with anyone. To protect his family, he had to leave his home for an enemy nation.
Yet, having arrived alone in the enemy nation, he found it wasn't as awful as his homeland's superiors claimed. He even met a close friend here who made him willing to trust others again.
I don't trust anyone else, I only trust you.
This is the line he said when he first met the protagonist, and it's also the one I believe best reflects the relationship between the two of them.
Now, could you please give us a performance for each of these three emotions: anger, regret, and joy?
Okay. Phew...
I don't trust anyone else, I only trust you!
I don't trust anyone else. I... only trust you.
I don't trust anyone else, I only trust you.
Buenas noches a todos. Soy Psion.
Quienes ya conocen mis hábitos seguro se van a sorprender de que publique hoy.
Siempre he considerado mi cumpleaños como día de descanso. No hago planes públicos. Y les agradezco que hayan sido comprensivos con ese pequeño capricho.
Hoy también estoy descansando, así que esta publicación no estaba en mis planes. Es solo algo personal que quería expresar.
Este año han pasado muchas cosas que antes jamás imaginaba...
Y la verdad... sí me han dejado ver un paisaje distinto.
A decir verdad, no puedo afirmar si es algo bueno o malo. Lo más adecuado sería decir— que es un ''cambio'', y que continuará.
Y por eso hoy decidí subir un video para todos.
Quiero decirles algo... el Psion que ustedes conocen, de aquí en adelante... o mejor dicho, ya está cambiando, poco a poco.
Yo lo he dicho: disfruto aceptar desafíos. El ''cambio'' también es uno de los más... fascinantes.
De ahora en adelante, cuente con eso. Sigan apoyándome y sean testigos de ello conmigo. Gracias a todos. Buenas noches.
A couple days ago, I saw someone share about fruit-filled dumplings. They looked so good I decided to try making them myself.
I won't bother taking pictures of the finished products. A few of them were wrapped poorly, and the skins tore.
The online tutorial says to use washed blueberries or strawberries for the filling without cutting them. Just wrap them in dumpling wrappers and serve with whipped cream and powdered sugar.
I've already added the whipped cream and powdered sugar. Let's give it a taste.
Nom...
This... is really good!
The sweet and tart berries perfectly balanced the richness of the whipped cream, and the powdered sugar was moist, a bit thick, and surprisingly like a sauce.
Making it yourself might not taste quite as authentic, but if you've got a sweet tooth, it's really worth a try.
Ever since I started taking calligraphy classes, I've been paying a bit more attention to the other courses offered at the community center.
Their courses are actually pretty diverse, the teaching style is very flexible, and chatting with the neighbors is also a lot of fun.
I heard from the seniors I met in calligraphy class that they also studied floral arrangement and weaving at the community center before.
Last week they invited me to a Zentangle workshop. I was worried drawing would be hard, but it turned out to be surprisingly easy.
Describing it as easy doesn't seem quite right either, I guess you could say it was relaxed and easygoing?
All you have to do is focus and repeat simple shapes. No rough drafts, and no erasing over and over just to make it perfect.
That feeling was truly magical. You unconsciously sink into a world where nothing else exists but paper, pen, the drawing, and yourself.
Overall, it was a pretty unique experience. I'll probably sign up once the official classes begin.
...I just hope they schedule the class at a time I can make it.

Good morning...
07:15 — Went for a jog.
Huff, huff... It rained last night, so running feels really nice...

08:15 — Got home and took a shower.
08:30 — Had breakfast and checked work schedule for the day.
09:00 — Left for work.
Today I'm doing a promotion gig with Lucé, so I have to go pick him up first.
What happens next is part of the job, so I have to stop recording for now.

19:00 — Went to calligraphy class.
But my phone happened to be dead, so I couldn't record.
20:30 — Got home. While waiting for the rice cooker to finish, I lifted some dumbbells.
Ten... eleven... twelve...
Took a short break after eating, then took a shower.
22:30 — Went to bed.
Good night. I hope you guys turn in early too.
Good evening, viewers, and welcome back to Summit Showdown! Let's welcome the challenger for today's limited-time bonus round: Mr. Gaen.
Hello, everyone.
The maximum score for the bonus round is 50 points, and the current record is 39. Mr. Gaen, how many points do you think you can earn for your team?
I'd say 46 points. I usually do outdoor rock climbing, so this course isn't a challenge for me.
At least, climbing up there and popping twenty balloons won't be a problem.
Wow, you're quite ambitious, young man. This won't be easy. Good luck, and please wait at the starting line.
Alright, thank you.
Summit Showdown Limited-Time Bonus Challenge: Start!
One, two, three!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten...
Twenty-one, twenty-two, twenty-three!
Finally—
Made it to the top! Phew... The score doubles for reaching the top, making it exactly 46 points, enough to set a new record.
Why isn't a single fish biting...
I'm using the the rod most recommended by the boss, with red worms for bait...
Did I pick the wrong bait? The sun's so bright, maybe I should switch to a white artificial lure and see how that works.
The bobber... I think it just bobbed a little.
It's not my imagination. The bobber really is swaying slightly from side to side.
...It sank.
Ready... *exhales*...
Now!
Got one—
What! Where'd that bird come from?!
My... my fish is gone...
Buenos días. Soy Gaen. Esta es mi transmisión de cumpleaños. Pueden dejar comentarios y conversar conmigo.
Mm... ¿por qué llevo el uniforme de la fuerza aérea? En realidad es el vestuario de «Alas de Acero II». La producción dijo que podía aprovechar para promocionar.
Veo un comentario: ''El uniforme se ve increíble. Pareces un piloto de verdad''... Ah... pues... sí, estudié en la academia de la fuerza aérea. Fui piloto unos años.
¿Les sorprende? ¿Por qué no lo había dicho? Porque no me parece nada especial...
Pero pensándolo bien... ya que acepté «Alas de Acero II», quizá conviene contar estas experiencias de vez en cuando. Lo voy a anotar.
Siento que he hablado demasiado de lo de ser piloto. Sirve para promocionar... pero creo que me salí del tema.
Por cierto, ¿qué se hace en una transmisión de cumpleaños? Solo he visto las de Lucé... Creo que respondía preguntas y pedía deseos, ¿no?
Hm... a ver... ¿qué preguntas hay...? ''¿Qué planes tienes para tu cumpleaños este año?''
No puedo decir el lugar exacto. Pero voy a ir a un lugar que me gusta.
¿Si voy solo? No, voy con Lucé.
Esperen... los comentarios van rapidísimo. ¡No alcanzo a leerlos todos!
...¿Quieren ver a Lucé? Debería estar en casa—
Ah, me está llamando.
Veo que me dicen que conteste, pero contestar una llamada en plena transmisión es un poco... Está bien, ya entendí.
¿Hola? Estoy en transmisión ahora mismo... ¿la estás viendo?
¿''Vengo a revisar cómo vas''? La forma de transmitir que me enseñaste no me queda...
¿Entonces me llamaste para enseñarme una ''manera adecuada''? ¿Cuál?
¿Desearme feliz cumpleaños? Mmm... gracias.
Esperen, ¿por qué siguen mandando regalos? ¡No hace falta! Mejor guarden su dinero y cómprense algo rico...
"Es el cumpleaños de Gaen, pero el que está comiendo dulce soy yo''... Con tantos comentarios así... ¿puedo interpretar que... se la están pasando bien?
Si esta transmisión de cumpleaños, poco ortodoxa, los está haciendo felices... entonces supongo que está bien.
En fin... gracias por las felicitaciones y los regalos. Ya me tengo que ir. Adiós.
*Blows*... Mm, it's still a little hot.
Good afternoon! Have you guys eaten yet? Let me share what I'm having right now—Pot Addiction's newest Love at First Taste Combo!
There's shrimp, premium meat, and even the egg dumplings and fish dumplings are handmade. It is totally to die for!
Excuse me, sir~ Just a heads-up, you have five minutes left on your challenge. If you go over time, you'll be charged for the meal.
No problem. Just give me five—no, three minutes, and I can polish off this pot.
Gulp!
It's really delicious. I thought it'd just be a typical hotpot, but they had an event where it's free if you finish within the time limit, so I came to try it.
I have no idea what these things in the broth are, but it tastes amazing.
The rest is all veggies. Here's a trick: soak these mushy-cooked veggies in the soup, mash them with a spoon, then gulp it down in one go—
Haaah~ I'm so full; that was awesome. And I even finished within the time limit.
Ah... damn it, the ice cream they're having looks so good... but the event doesn't include the buffet bar's ice cream and desserts...
Never mind. Next time I'll bring someone else to eat with me, then we'll come back and pig out on this place's ice cream!
Just sharing with you guys! I just got out of the shower and realized my recent training is really paying off.
Especially my glutes and delts—so my barbell hip thrusts and face pulls weren't for nothing.
The more I look at it, the more accomplished I feel. Give me a sec, let me adjust the camera to show you guys... This is my ultimate muscle goal. The trainer at that gym is really amaz–
Cough!
Ah, cough, cough!
...It's actually kinda cold wearing so little. I have a match next week, so I can't catch a cold... I'd better put my clothes on first.
Whoa it's really cold; I've even got goosebumps. I'll show you guys next time if I get the chance, hahaha! Bye-bye for now!
Yo~ I'm out here today. The scenery along this highway is pretty great, huh?
Getting out for some fresh air is exactly what days off are for. Especially with weather this nice, going for a ride is an absolute must.
...Over there, I hear birds. One, no, it's a pair.
Oh right, in that direction, I remember there's an old brewery in the next county over that he said was pretty good...
Since I'm out anyway, might as well go take a look. I can even buy a few bottles to bring home!
Alright, I'd better hit the road before it gets dark.
I listen to music when I work out, but I've gotten bored of my playlist lately.
I'm getting tired of this one too... if I remember right, this isn't the genre for me...
Hmm? Isn't this the boys' song? It's on the recommended list.
Now that I think about it, I don't think I'd ever heard their songs before. And I just happened to be out of town for a competition on the day of their debut concert.
Hmm, I should give it a listen...
Wooaaahh~ As expected of the boys! It sounds amazing and makes you feel completely fired up!
Alright, I'll put this track on repeat today and knock out a few sets of bench presses.
Hmm? Have I already looked around here?
I knew it. I was just playing darts right here, and I still have the prize in my hand.
Ah, it's a parade.
The guy at the very end is handing out longevity candy. Man, I miss that... used to get it all the time for offeri—
...used to be offered that to eat, to pray the match goes smoothly and safely.
I remember it being crunchy and kind of hard, but I can't really recall the flavor.
So many people... and they're almost all kids. Kids all love candy after all.
Sigh, the little brats at home are the same. Every time they get longevity candy, they scarf it all down in one go. If I want any, I've gotta fight them for it.
How nice... Longevity candy is pretty rare nowadays. To actually see it here, it must've been specially prepared for them.
Well, as a dependable adult, of course I can't fight them for candy.
...Maybe I should just go grab a few.
Sorry, could I have two longevity candies, please!

¡Todo lo que dije recién fue en vano!
Ya, ya... ¡da igual!
¡Gracias por las felicitaciones, todos! ¡Hoy es mi cumpleaños!
¡Ahora ando fuera del país con el equipo para una carrera!
Ay~ esta vez solo quedamos en segundo lugar... perdón por decepcionarlos.
Mm... gracias por el ánimo. La verdad sí estoy un poco desanimado.
Pero viendo sus mensajes... ya me siento mucho mejor.
Ah, el equipo ya me está llamando.
En un rato termino de guardar mis cosas y mañana vuelvo.
¡Eso! ¿Se saben mi agenda? ¡La próxima carrera de clasificación va a ser en Ciudad Empírea!
¡Ahhhh, ya voy en seguida!

I've been looking for ages, and today I actually managed to find the first volume by surprise.
The author's writing is wonderfully nuanced, and his hand-drawn illustrations are beautifully crafted and easy to follow. The story is heartwarming and inspiring, perfect for reading together with family. It's my favorite picture book I've read so far, and I highly recommend it to everyone.
Thanks to all the love you've given us, Starfire can shine bright even in the darkest night!

There's a 5,000-piece puzzle I've had my eye on, but I didn't order it because I was worried I wouldn't have time to put it together. But today I happened to win some seasonal gift cards in a lucky draw, and put together, the amount is exactly the same as the cost of the puzzle. Is a higher power telling me that I should buy it...?

Thanks to everyone's support, the Starry Idol project was a complete success. Your survey responses and encouragement on our fan page have given us a lot of strength.

We're currently discussing a long-term partnership with the planetarium, so that more people can see the beauty of the starry sky. We hope to see you again soon under the stars.

Ryut
Ended up signing up for a skateboard DIY class on a whim. Using an airbrush was harder than I expected, but it was also a lot of fun. I recommend giving it a try if you ever get the chance.

Ran into a Flint at the airport. It caught me off guard a bit, so I wasn't sure if I reacted appropriately... But while I was worrying about that, they ended up being the one to encourage me... I'm really happy to know what we've been trying to convey has come through, and I'm truly, truly grateful for all your warmth and support.
Asked @Towa for tips on making red date and black sesame scones. It was way easier than I expected, and low-cal too. Hopefully it'll be enough to keep a certain bottomless pit fed.
Went on a location scout with Asahi today. We ran into a bunch of unexpected things, and even a lucky find!
Last time I stayed out late at night... was probably back in high school?
Stumbled across an award certificate from a student songwriting competition back in the day. I listened through the piece I wrote for it again, and... it certainly brings back memories.

Asahi and I went back to our alma mater to film a variety show, and the kids there were very curious about what we were like when we were little. Because of time constraints, we couldn't put everything about our time in school into the show. But I've always believed that it's those days that made us who we are today. That place is full of memories. I'm looking forward to taking you down memory lane once the show airs.
Popsicle <sprite name=SNS_EM_VIB_009>
Anyone in Empyrea District of Empyrea City?
Good morning. I forgot to charge my phone...

Asahi always ruffles my hair when he gets excited. It's one thing to have my hair turned into a total mess... but lately, the stylists have started asking if I'm trying to go for a "bedhead look" on purpose <sprite name=SNS_EM_MOO_013>
My neighbor has flowers in front of their house. They were just tiny, candy-like buds before, but today when I passed them, the flowers were in full bloom. A cat was even snoozing under the bushes.
I can't seem to sleep at night, but by the time noon rolls around, I'm always drowsy. Especially in winter, napping by the window in the sun is the best...
The little supermarket down the street had a buy-two-get-one-free sale on toilet paper, so now our dorm is stocked up for at least three months
I love the cardboard boxes from online shopping. After checking that all my items are in order, piling them in the corner into a fort makes me feel relaxed somehow...
Maybe stepping outside for a bit to clear my head might help me find some new inspiration?
For some reason, lately my homepage recommendations are full of all kinds of sleep ASMR...
Decided to make a jar of candied lemon, and now the whole place smells amazing!
Sometimes I write lyrics until the deep of night. There isn't much noise outside the window, save for the streetlamp that lies awake alone, guttering with a subtle buzz.

Hi everyone, I'm Ryut, an idol in training at Ark Entertainment. It's a pleasure to meet you all in this fan club.

We're still practicing hard for our debut, hoping to bring you the most amazing performance. We'll share any new updates with everyone through the fan club, so please stay tuned. Thank you all for your support.
Sometimes we should just feel our feelings. We don't have to force ourselves to be happy.
Spent the day tidying up the room, doing the laundry, and reading a bit. Before I knew it, the sky had already gone dark... Weekends are never nearly long enough.

Another year older now.

Lately I keep finding myself wondering: Are you prouder of the person I am now than the one I was last year? It's only because of all the Flints supporting me every step of the way that I've been able to keep moving forward. I'm so glad I got to meet you all. I hope we will be there for each other in the future too.

Thank you all for coming to Starfire's debut performance. I wouldn't say it was perfect, but I hope we left you with some good memories. Thank you for helping us give everything we could on stage. And thanks for waving your lightsticks. They were like a million stars illuminating our path forward.

Ryut

Our new song showcase wrapped up without a hitch. We tried something a little different this time around, so I was honestly worried our fans might not take to it, but the response has been beyond anything I expected. Thank you so much for all your support. Starfire will keep working hard to bring you even better music.

Ryut

Huff... Is anyone... in the Empyrea District right now? We're shooting outdoors, huff... and we're required to find a lady dressed in red from top to toe! If you are around, please help! (Over here! I found a photo studio—we can ask them!)
I remembered as far as to plug in my charger yesterday, but apparently I forgot to turn it on... I have 30% battery to last me through the morning. Please wish me luck.

Good afternoon. We are deeply grateful for your continued support for Seasoned Embers. The viewership ratings have become increasingly stable recently, and for that, I offer my sincerest thanks.

I have recently been planning the weekly recommended cooking lessons for the program. This segment is designed to help everyone enjoy the pleasure of cooking. Therefore, I would like to ask: Is there any particular dish you are interested in learning to prepare?

Earlier, while filming on location, the vendors at the market were all so friendly. I even met an elderly lady from a rice shop who said she's a loyal viewer. She warmly welcomed our group into her store and gifted us a generous amount of pickled vegetables. Our crew practically ended up with a jar each.

I also currently have several bags of rice in the car. The lady said I look "too skinny" and insisted I take them. She told me not to focus only on cooking for others as a chef, but to also take good care of myself.

Now I finally understand the expression "when Grandma thinks you're hungry." I am truly grateful to her, and I hope she always stays healthy and full of energy.

Good afternoon. Today, we have Chef Eddie with us from one of the world's top 100 restaurants, here to teach us some classic international dishes. If you find yourself with no appetite in the heat of summer and would like a tangy, sweet, and mildly spicy tomato stew to whet your palate, or if you're curious about how to keep chickpea pancakes crispy on the outside yet soft on the inside, then be sure to tune in to "Seasoned Embers" right on time.

I've got a sudden craving to soak in a hot spring and have some warm rice wine.

I've already called all the costume rental shops nearby. One shop said they can help, but we're still short on quantity. Does anyone living nearby have anything they can lend us? We'll pay to rent it. Any assistance is appreciated!

Three days ago, torrential rain came. It was not just rain that fell upon the land; there was also something grotesque that seemed to come from beyond the sky.

A bizarre color clung to the rainwater, seeping into every crevice of the abandoned ancient city. In an instant, the color covered the entire city, emitting a faint, peculiar luminescence of a star.

Early the next morning, the city was completely desolate, as if nothing had ever happened, and as if it had never existed.

—Chapter 3, Section VI, From Beyond by Luv Kraft

If you liked what you heard, please visit the publisher's official website to purchase the audiobook. In addition to the original version voiced by a professional voice actor, you will also receive a bonus version read by me. Thank you for your support.

Yesterday, a female skeleton was excavated at Mount Farcrest. Inside a dirt pit large enough to accommodate a human body, suspected burial goods were discovered, indicating that relatively mature burial concepts already existed in the era.

Interestingly, the patterns on the burial goods share several distinct similarities with the engraved symbols previously found at Boundless Lake. Perhaps this new discovery will allow us to finally break through the fog that has clouded the previous research.

I'm really looking forward to seeing how this unfolds...

In this stifling, humid weather that kills your appetite, the best thing is to mix up a drink with yuzu liqueur and vodka in a chilled glass. Just one sip, and that sticky feeling on your skin vanishes in an instant along with your fatigue.

Battle Info
About the Battle

All Vows and monsters have four types:
[Ruby], [Sapphire], [Emerald], and [Topaz].

These four types counter each other in a cycle.

Type advantage directly affects Damage, Crit Rate, and Accuracy.

The Vow in Position 1 (leftmost) has a higher chance of becoming targeted by enemies. Assigning a Vow with high HP and Defense in this Position can greatly improve your chances in battle!

If the enemy has not locked on to the Vow in Position 1, Vows with a type disadvantage will be prioritized instead, followed by those with low HP.

Vows have 4 Roles:

: Balanced in offense and defense; can withstand damage and deal stable damage.

: Has the highest Attack values; excels at defeating enemies quickly.

: Can restore a Vow's HP or provide support effects.

: Has the highest survivability; suitable for the 1st position.
Tap the <color=#273CF5>stopwatch</color> icon on the bottom-left corner during battle to view the turn order, along with details regarding active buffs and debuffs on both your team and the enemy.

On the turn order page, tap the magnifying glass icon to view skill details for your Vows and the enemies.

During battle, tap the enemy's information at the top to view its skill details.
Before entering the battle, tap <color=#273CF5>Enemies</color> at the information page about the stage to view details about the enemies' skills and immunity.

When inflicting a debuff on a target, the target has a certain chance of resisting it. Bosses have a higher chance to resist Debuffs.
When the target resists the debuff successfully, a pop-up Resist indication will be displayed on the target.

Details about the enemy's additional resistance chances can be viewed in Immunity Info.

When a Vow casts a Battle Skill, its allies have a chance to trigger Flanking, using their own Battle Skills to attack the same target.
Flanking will not be triggered by a counter attack.

Shield: The amount of damage absorbed is proportional to the caster's Max HP.

Restoring HP: The amount of HP restored is proportional to the caster's Max HP.

Haha! I can finally give my wings a good stretch!
Yo! Let's go crush all the levels!
Oooh! Divinity is starting to surge! Looks like now's a good time to move out!
I can't hide my ears and tail... Hmm? You find it soothing? That's good then.
Proper rest is also part of the bigger plan. Here, take these supplies.
Looks like our timing is spot on. It's time to head out again.
Feather care is no small matter. Taking in enough nutrients is the only way to sustain strong wings.
All preparations are complete. Time to flip on the sign? The restaurant's about to open.
Here's a souvenir I brought back from abroad. It'll give you a real boost of energy~
Let's lie on the grass together and feel the breeze brush against our skin, hmm?
You want to relax by petting something fluffy? Hehe~ sure you can.
Pick whatever you like, it's my treat~
I made this fox moon candy. Care to try some?
You'll need plenty of stamina to overcome the trials ahead.
If you're tired, how about listening to some music and taking a break?
You've got to stay hydrated after a workout. Here, drink up.
Even if you're really busy, you still need to eat right. If you can't step away... maybe we can order delivery together?
You've worked hard. I've got plenty of little sweets in my drawer. Feel free to help yourself.
A regular diet and daily routine are the first step to protecting the mortal realm.
Good work, here's your strawberry milk.
I enjoy watching that dumb doggy smile while devouring his food more than actually making it.
There you are. Let's turn these into motivation to practice!
Hehe~ You just gotta have a can of orange soda after a workout!
Wiggle-wiggle, waggy-waggy... I wonder if Ryut will come brush my fur?

Using a Vow's Battle Skill should take care of the monster.

Any [Vow] that can act will glow. Tap to use a [Battle Skill] to attack.

An even stronger one this time? Aether imbalance is such a pain~

Let's use a powerful [Ultimate]. Tap the button below the Vow to cast it.

Let's take a look at the types present on the field. Our type is <color=#0066CC>[Sapphire]</color>, countering the enemy's <color=#EA0000>[Ruby]</color> perfectly. With the type advantage, we can unleash greater power.
Oh, the features in the top right have been unlocked! These features will make combat easier to master. Let's check them out together.

This is the [Battle Speed] button.

You can adjust the speed at any time.
If you want to save time, try switching to a higher speed!

Introducing <color=#273CF5>[Auto-Battle]</color>! When active, the system automatically targets type weaknesses and uses skills to boost efficiency. Let's try <color=#273CF5>[Auto-Battle]</color> now.

Phew~ crisis averted! What you learned sure came in handy, huh?

And the most important feature is unlocked too! Let's check it out!

Here, tap the [Confirm] button!

This is the [Main Story]!

It is the core of our adventure. Enjoy the story, and unlock more useful features as you progress. Advance when you can!

Now, tap the top-left!

This is the [Stage Menu]! You can read stories or farm materials here.

Next, tap top left to return to the [Lobby].
Hehe, the moment is upon us! Which <color=#273CF5>Vow</color> awaits us? Ready? Let's take a look!

Here we have the [Vow Gallery]. All your Vows are stored here!

Tap on the new Vow you just got!

Check the Vows' Rarity, Type, Skills, and current Stats here.

The higher a Vow's Level, the stronger it is. Let's learn how to Level Up now!

Not bad at all~ Look who's getting good at this!

Asahi and Ryut's performance is about to start. Let's hurry over so we don't miss anything~
Tap here. Let's <color=#273CF5>Level Up</color> this Vow!

Consume Vitality Drinks to Level Up, and improve the Vow's stats!

Now let's go ahead and Level Up~
Isn't leveling up super easy? Your <color=#273CF5>Stats</color> just got stronger, so future battles will be a breeze! Now, let's continue the adventure!

At the bottom-right is the [Main Story]. This shows our current progress, and even the visuals look exciting!

Tap to enter now.
Next up is <color=#273CF5>[1-5]</color>. Tap here to jump back in and see where the story takes us next.
Tap <color=#273CF5>[Auto-Form]</color>. Let the system assign your team so you can head into battle right away!

Final reminder!

The one in Position 1 is our leader. As our first line of defense, the leader is more likely to be attacked. Be sure to assign a Vow with higher HP there!
All set! The lineup is ready. Tap <color=#273CF5>[Start Battle]</color>! Let's head out and win the next battle!

[Ascension] requires [Vow Shards]!

Extra Vows become [Vow Shards] based on their Rarity, so duplicates won't be wasted—Use them to ascend your Vows and become stronger!

The rules are simple~

Complete [Daily] and [Weekly] Missions to earn the corresponding [Activity].

Start with the easy Missions, and your [Activity] will build up fast!

Progress through the story and earn rewards in [Fated Gift]!

Hehe, our Boss prepared all these. Tap [Claim] to accept them!
Reach the <color=#273CF5>[Activity]</color> goals to claim <color=#273CF5>[Activity Rewards]</color>. Clear <color=#273CF5>[Daily]</color> & <color=#273CF5>[Weekly]</color> Missions for Gems & items.

Also, claim [Activity Rewards] to get [Account EXP] and increase your Player Rank.

A higher Player Rank unlocks more gameplay features and content.

And don't forget the reset time!

[Daily Mission] and [Weekly Mission] resets at the following times:

[Daily Mission] resets daily at 00:00 (UTC+8);
[Weekly Mission] resets every Sunday at 00:00 (UTC+8).

Let's get all the Activity Rewards before time runs out!
In the <color=#273CF5>[Fan Club]</color>, you can track everyone's latest updates anytime. Find out what everyone's been up to recently!
Asahi and I just posted new updates in the <color=#273CF5>[Fan Club]</color>. I hope you'll like what we shared. Tap here to check it out!

A first post after our practice! After our first dress rehearsal, now Asahi and I are one step closer to our official debut.

Even though I feel excited and nervous, we will do our best.
You can interact with us via the posts! Tap [Comment] to share your thoughts and earn Fan Club Points. If you like something, tap on the [Heart] to encourage us. Come interact with me!

Want to see more interesting posts? As long as you <color=#273CF5>read the stories</color>, <color=#273CF5>grow your Vows</color>, and <color=#273CF5>obtain more Vows</color>, you can see more of our updates here. All our memories are recorded here, so remember to visit the Fan Club often!
<color=#273CF5>[Mystic Challenge]</color> is the main source of Level-Up materials. If you want to nurture your Vows and boost their combat power, you'll want to check in here every day.
<color=#273CF5>[Argent Bounty]</color> is a great place to earn Silver! Promoting a Vow costs a lot of Silver. If you're short on Silver, you've come to the right place.

This is your [Team]! Up to 4 Vows can join.

We can't let Ryut fight monsters alone... Tap on a [Team Slot].
Clear <color=#273CF5>[Vitality Springs]</color> to obtain Vitality Drinks for Vows. Using Vitality Drinks to raise Vow levels is the most effective way to increase combat power.

<color=#273CF5>[Crystal]</color> is the promotion material for Vows. It comes in 4 types: <color=#EA0000>Ruby</color>, <color=#0066CC>Sapphire</color>, <color=#009100>Emerald</color>, & <color=#C6A300>Topaz</color>. When a Vow reaches its level cap, it requires the matching Crystal to promote!
When you run short on materials, come back here and challenge! This is our best source of supplies, so make good use of it to grow stronger.
Why, here it is! This is the <color=#273CF5>[Spiritwing Pursuit]</color>.

This is [Mortal Pursuit].

Each Pursuit costs one [Spiritwing], for a chance to encounter an R–SR Vow or Vow Shard.

The [Divine Pursuit] requires the rarer [Luminous Spiritwing], but you may encounter an SR or even an SSR Vow!

If you don't have enough, complete Schedule Missions or exchange them in the Shop.

How about less talk and more action? Let's dive right in and try [Mortal Pursuit]!

Please tap here for me.
Tap <color=#273CF5>[Confirm]</color> to start your pursuit. Who knows what unexpected encounter awaits? I'm so excited~

A pursuit usually takes 8 hours, but if you have a [Guiding Compass], you can skip the wait and complete it immediately.

We happen to have one right now, so let's enjoy the convenience of instant completion together!

<color=#273CF5>[Phantom Trial]</color> is a higher-difficulty challenge. You get <color=#273CF5>3</color> attempts daily. Clear floors for rich rewards! Don't forget to drop by daily and test your strength!

Now you can choose a Vow you own.

Hehe, say, doesn't the new guy look super reliable?

This is the record of everyone's exclusive <color=#273CF5>[Chronicles]</color>. Besides the story, there are also battle stages to complete. The Chronicle Tokens obtained from clearing the battles can be exchanged for various rewards. Let's work hard together and bring home every reward!
Equip the <color=#273CF5>[SSR Vow]</color> of the current event to instantly boost them to Lv. 80! You'll clear faster and earn extra tokens. Let's go! Equip them and knock out the stages!
But remember: Chronicles have a <color=#273CF5>time limit</color>! Finish the story and claim all rewards before time runs out so you don't miss out!
Last but not least... thank you, everyone! Your support inspires us to keep updating exciting new stories. We truly appreciate it!
First, we see the <color=#273CF5>[Character]</color> tab. Tap here to replace the character in the lobby!
Hehe, now I'm the one in the lobby! Next, let's tap the <color=#273CF5>[Expression]</color> tab.
All character expressions are listed here. Let's select the <color=#273CF5>[Eyes Closed]</color> expression.
Look! My expression has already switched to <color=#273CF5>Eyes Closed</color>. Next, let's tap the <color=#273CF5>[Outfit]</color> button!

Although we haven't collected other outfits yet, we can still <color=#273CF5>preview</color> them! Let's tap the <color=#273CF5>[Magnifying Glass]</color> and see what my first stage outfit looks like.
Tap here to place <color=#273CF5>a second character</color>! The Lobby can house up to two characters at the same time, livening up the atmosphere.
See the <color=#273CF5>[+]</color> button at the top? Tap on it to add the Vow to your team!
Tap here to change the <color=#273CF5>[Lobby Background]</color>, so we can customize our personal space.
Tap here to access the <color=#273CF5>[Music Settings]</color>, so every moment in the lobby has the perfect accompaniment.

Position: Hold and drag.

We can also directly place a <color=#273CF5>Vow</color> on the lobby screen. Tap this button to try it out!
All <color=#273CF5>Vows you own</color> will be listed here. Choose the Vow you like to complete the setup!
If you want to view other characters, just tap here again to switch back to the <color=#273CF5>[Character]</color> tab.
The system also provides <color=#273CF5>5 loadouts</color> for your lobby setups, making it easy to quickly switch between different presets.

Lastly, check out [Lobby Carousel]! Tap [Shuffle] to save your current setup to the carousel. From then on, each time you switch screens, the carousel will cycle to the next setup.

That's all for lobby settings—now go make your lobby look amazing!

Great, now Ryut and I are ready!

Now Tap [Start Battle] to begin!

Next, I'll explain the combat tactics. All Vows and monsters have four types:

[Ruby] [Sapphire]
[Emerald] [Topaz]
These four types counter each other in a cycle. Type advantage directly affects <color=#273CF5>Damage</color>, <color=#273CF5>Crit Rate</color>, and <color=#273CF5>Hit Rate</color>.
